specs.Compatible Devices: Smartphones, Laptops, Media Players with Screen Mirroring/Wireless Capabilities

features: Smart LED Projector: Portronics Beem 470 is a smart LED projector. Crafted with precision, this portable projector’s stunning visuals and better than ever user interface will take your home theater experience to a whole new level.

Streaming Your Entertainment: It comes with Android 11-based OS, for direct access to a wide range of streaming services. Now seamlessly watch content from popular OTT platforms like- Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+ Hotstar, YouTube, and more.

Bright and Sharp Visuals: The projector’s 1080p Full HD resolution and 4500 lumens brightness, ensure that your movies, shows, sports, etc. are always displayed in high-definition quality and impressive brightness, even in well-lit spaces.

Auto Keystone Correction: Beem 470 adopts automatic vertical correction and manual focus for distortion free images every time. Make precise screen adjustments without needing to reposition the projector.

Adjustable Screen Size: This projector for home has an adjustable screen size from 40 inches to 150 inches with a projection distance ranging between 1.2 m to 4 m. Enjoy your movies, and games on a grand screen size.
